notes.title: Ancestors Legacy console release is here!
notes.notes:
Ancestors Legacy, so far the most complex game from Destructive Creations, releases today on PS4 and Xbox One, retailing at the price of EUR 34.99 / USD 39.99, with a 15% launch discount on PlayStation Store US.

Later this year, a physical version of the game for PlayStation 4 including bonus material will be made available in selected retail stores for EUR 39.99, as will the PS4 digital and retail versions for Japan and Asia.

With porting support from Slipgate Ironworks, Ancestors Legacy is bringing all its main features to consoles: an enticing history-inspired storyline, tactical squad-based battles, day-night cycle, action camera, pleasing visuals on a par with the PC version, and the extra hours of gameplay in skirmish and online multiplayer modes.

The addition of a first-rate RTS to non-PC platforms, where such titles are scarce, has been highly anticipated by many gamers and Ancestors Legacy will not let them down in terms of content, quality and accessibility via the controller, the use of which has been prepared and tested for right from the very beginning. Following a challenging development for PC, additional free updates and a paid DLC, the porting of the game was no easy task, and having finally brought it to the remaining platforms is a gratification for the whole team. The cooperation with Slipgate Ironworks on the PS4 build cannot be stressed enough.

https://youtu.be/WGQo-YgmVcI

notes.title: THE DRUMS OF BATTLE BEAT EVER NEARER! Important Tournament Updates and Changes!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/1b2aa7e597ed97f44cc145d799dd452897dfdb56.jpg
Registration is still open! 
https://opnoobs.com/e4i/ancestors-legacy/details

Important Tournament Updates!

1: Due to technical difficulties the tournament will no longer be run on dedicated servers. 
2: The structure of the tournament has changed from best of 1 matches to best of 3. 
3: Due to the tournament being opened to all regions, the start time of the tournament has changed. 

Our goal is to provide fun and accessible e-sports events and tournaments for gaming communities across the globe. We hope these changes do not drastically affect your ability to compete and enjoy the tournament this weekend. If you have any questions or concerns do not hesitate to reach out to any member of the E4I staff on the OPNOOBS Discord https://discord.gg/svGrT4d. You can also reach out to NedMeeker@OPNOOBS.com -
Ned Meeker: Chief of Staff
Esports-4-Indie


Please see the new tournament schedule and the full list of changes below:

Tournament schedule:
Day 1:
Date: Saturday, July 21st 
Check-in: 1:30 PM - 2:30 PM CEST
Tournament starts at 3:00 PM CEST
Day 2: 
Date: Sunday, July 22nd
Pre-show/Stream: 2:30 PM CEST
Check-in: 1:30 PM - 2:30 PM CEST
Finals start: 3:00 PM CEST

Registration and Check-In: Registration closes on Saturday, July 21st at 2:30 PM CEST. Players are required to check-in via Battlefy between 1:30 PM and 2:30 PM CEST to be seeded into a pool. If you fail to check-in, you will not be seeded into the tournament.

Basic Structure: The tournament will be split into two days, with Rounds 1-4 occurring on Saturday, July 21st and Top 4 (Rounds 5 and 6) occuring on July 22nd. The tournament will be a 64-man single-elimination tournament. All matches will be Best of 3 games. All matches will be played as private matches created by the upper player in the bracket.
Match Procedure: 

Match Setup: For all matches, four maps are available for play: Burnt and Ruined, Deceptive Calm, Lost Heritage, Tribal Wars. For the first game of a match, the upper player picks the first map and selects their race before the lower player. The lower player then selects their race and the match begins.

Match Settings (all default except for Time Limit):
Game Mode: Domination
Domination Score: 3500
Starting Resources: 100%
Starting Tier: 1
Time Limit: 45:00
Starting Weather: Random
Maximum Squads: 10
Level Bracket: Any
Game Type: PvP

Match Reporting: Players report their games via the match page on Battlefy. Players are required to submit screenshots of the results screen of each game in case a match dispute is filed. Please update the score after each match. Updating the score informs the admins you are ready for your next match. Failure to do so will result in delays starting your next game.

Subsequent Games: After reporting the first game’s score, the lower player then picks map and race first for the second map, following the same procedure as was done in the first map (including having an admin set up the dedicated server). If the map score is tied, whoever loses the second map then selects map and race first for the third map. 

Top 4: Top 4 of the tournament begins on Sunday, July 22nd at 3 PM CEST. Finals follow the same match procedure as listed in 3.3.  The players who lose in the semi-final matches will face each other for third place.

Top 4 Match Procedure: Match procedure is the same as above, except players must wait until given the go-ahead by a tournament organizer via Discord when all spectators have joined a game. If all spectators are not in the lobby, the match will be restarted promptly, with map and race selections remaining the same.


Prizes:

1st Place: Ryzen 2600 CPU, Collector's Edition Prize Pack (Retail copy, mug, t-shirt, and coin), Hearts of Iron IV, Conan Exiles, Destiny 2, Mafia III + the Sign of the Times DLC, The Escapists 2, Dead Rising 4, Endless Space 2, Kerbal Space Program, Skullgirls 4 Pack, The Technomancer, Outlast 2, Rising Storm 2: Vietnam - Digitial Deluxe Edition, Ruiner, and Empire: Total War Collection.

2nd Place: Collector's Edition Prize Pack (retail copy, mug, t-shirt, and coin), Hearts of Iron IV, Conan Exiles, Destiny 2, and The Escapists 2. 

3rd Place: Ancestors Legacy Wooden Mug (x2), and Titan Quest Anniversary Edition.

notes.title: Community update. Well, sort of...
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
In case you're wondering, we're still working hard on improving Ancestors Legacy. A reasonably big update is heading your way, hopefully still in June, so I wanted to take this opportunity and somewhat tease its contents:
The work on dedicated servers for the game is going good - we'd like to set them up still this month, should gods be with us.
We have an idea how to let more of you try out the game before you decide to give us your hard earned money. Something similar to our pre-launch open beta, but not exactly...
Our community deserves all the best, so we work restlessly to bring you a fully professional tournament. It will take much more than a free weekend and couple passionate community members to do it this time around. Bear with us.
We have our eyes and minds focused on much more cool stuff we can expand the game with, like workshop support, new features and/or modes? But that's top secret stuff for now, only in properly labelled documents stored deep in our armored vaults!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/7433901936c4b5951cffb7eaac4537f5836c11fe.jpg

Oh, and the image? It's a totally random screenshot from some dedicated server stress-tests that we did yesterday. It was... inspiring.

Open Beta just started!

We're excited to announce that the multiplayer open beta version of Ancerstors Legacy is now available to everyone! Head over to the Open Beta store page and download it right now. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Ancestors Legacy Multiplayer Beta is LIVE
notes.notes:
We will send out the Steam keys to EVERYONE who registered and confirmed the e-mail address through our beta sign up page: http://destructivecreations.pl/beta

Also, we've seen many people play the beta already through the weekend. Thanks to everyone who shared the impressions, either by streaming, posting a video, using the feedback/bug forms available from the game's main menu, or even sending a crash report. It helps a lot!
We are going to patch the beta in a day or two. The most important tweaks:
- Additional AI difficulties.
- The match starts automatically after a short delay, when the map is loaded.
- When the player waits too long for a Quick Match, he/she will automatically host a listen server.

Bear in mind that we do not have dedicated servers, so creating your own server raises your chances for successful matchmaking drastically.
Last but not least, due to the game's complexity and complete lack of tutorials in our multiplayer mode, it's highly advisable to at least browse the Manual. You can find it in the game's main menu, or here: https://doc.destructivecreations.pl/AL_MP_Beta_Guide_Dec2017.pdf

See you in the battlefield!

UPDATE: We've decided to prolong the key giveaway and we will be sending keys to everyone who signed up already and to anyone who signs up till the end of Friday 15.12.2017 23:59 CET.
